Dominion Admin","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system serves high-velocity enterprise operators managing complex fleet, infrastructure, and administrative workflows. The aesthetic balance reflects precision engineering, clarity, and authority. Visual weight is deliberately understated to prioritize high-density data legibility, fast scanning, and zero-distraction administrative operations.

- **Design Philosophy:** Minimalist Functionalism combined with Modern Corporate Enterprise standards.
- **Visual Tenets:**
  - High information density without visual crowding.
  - Razor-sharp visual hierarchy driven by typography and structural hairline boundaries.
  - White surface containment against cool slate background tones.
  - Contextual color reserved strictly for statuses, actionable triggers, and critical alerts.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a fixed-sidebar layout paired with a 12-column fluid grid tailored for wide-format desktop displays (minimum target 1280px up to 4K workstations).

- **Global Layout Structure:**
  - **Global Sidebar:** Fixed 240px width (collapsible to 64px icon-rail mode for data-heavy viewports).
  - **Header Bar:** 52px fixed height, containing breadcrumb navigation, environmental selectors, search, and admin profile access.
  - **Canvas Canvas Pad:** Fixed 24px (`space-xl`) outer margins for full screen, reflowing to 16px (`space-lg`) on sub-1440px desktop screens.
- **Rhythm & Grid:**
  - Standard gutters are `1rem` (16px) with a compact density variant of `0.75rem` (12px) for analytical dashboards.
  - Row density inside tables and forms adheres to strict 32px (compact), 38px (regular), and 44px (spacious) vertical slot baselines.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual separation relies on structured borders and tonal shifts rather than dramatic floating drop shadows.

- **Border Hierarchy:**
  - Surface separation is driven by 1px solid hairline borders in `#e2e8f0`.
  - Focused or active structural boundaries shift to `#2563eb` with no layout shift.
- **Card Depth:**
  - Standard Cards: `#ffffff` surface, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, subtle ambient drop: `0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
  - Hovered Actionable Cards: Surface unchanged, border `#cbd5e1`, shadow: `0px 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), 0px 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Flyouts & Dropdowns:**
  - Dropdown Menus & Popovers: `#ffffff`, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, shadow: `0px 10px 15px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0px 4px 6px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`.
  - Modals & Side Sheets: `#ffffff`, backdrop overlay `#0f172a` at 40% opacity (`rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.40)`), with `0px 20px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Dark slate background `#1e293b`, white text, 32px height (desktop compact) or 36px (default), 4px border-radius, font-size 13px, font-weight 500, padding: 0 12px. Hover: `#0f172a`.
- **Accent (Action):** Background `#2563eb`, white text, hover: `#1d4ed8`.
- **Secondary / Outline:** Background `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#e2e8f0`, text `#0f172a`. Hover: `#f8fafc`, border `#cbd5e1`.
- **Destructive:** Background `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#fecaca`, text `#dc2626`. Hover: `#fef2f2`, border `#dc2626`.
- **Ghost / Icon-only:** Background transparent, text `#475569`, hover background `#f1f5f9`.

### Data Tables
- **Header:** Height 34px, background `#f8fafc`, border-bottom 1px solid `#e2e8f0`, typography `label-sm` in `#475569`, text-transform uppercase.
- **Rows:** Height 38px, background `#ffffff`, border-bottom 1px solid `#f1f5f9`, hover state `#f8fafc`.
- **Selection:** Checkbox column fixed at 40px width, selected rows highlight with background `#eff6ff` and left border `#2563eb`.

### Status Badges & Chips
- Status chips have a fixed height of 20px, 4px border-radius, padding 0 6px, typography `label-sm` (11px, weight 600).
  - **Approve:** Text `#16a34a`, background `#f0fdf4`, border 1px solid `#bbf7d0`.
  - **Pending:** Text `#57534e`, background `#f5f5f4`, border 1px solid `#e7e5e4`.
  - **Warning:** Text `#b45309`, background `#fffbeb`, border 1px solid `#fde68a`.
  - **Alert:** Text `#dc2626`, background `#fef2f2`, border 1px solid `#fecaca`.

### Form Inputs & Selectors
- **Input Fields:** Height 32px (compact) or 36px (default), background `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#cbd5e1`, font-size 13px, text `#0f172a`.
- **Focus State:** Border color `#2563eb`, box-shadow `0 0 0 1px #2563eb`.
- **Placeholder:** `#94a3b8`.
- **Error State:** Border color `#dc2626`, box-shadow `0 0 0 1px #dc2626`.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Size 14px x 14px, border 1px solid `#cbd5e1`, border-radius 3px (checkbox) or circular (radio).
- Checked: Background `#2563eb`, border `#2563eb`, check glyph white. Focus ring: 2px offset with `#93c5fd`.

### Cards & Metrics Tiles
- Metric KPI tiles feature a 1px border `#e2e8f0`, background `#ffffff`, padding 16px.
- Displays small uppercase category label (`label-sm`), large quantitative value (`headline-lg` with tabular numbers), and contextual change indicator chip inline.

### Navigation Sidebar
- Background `#1e293b` (Dark Slate), width 240px.
- Nav Items: 34px height, 4px corner radius, text `#94a3b8`, font-size 13px, padding 0 10px.

## Brand & Style

This design system serves high-velocity enterprise operators managing complex fleet, infrastructure, and administrative workflows. The aesthetic balance reflects precision engineering, clarity, and authority. Visual weight is deliberately understated to prioritize high-density data legibility, fast scanning, and zero-distraction administrative operations.

- **Design Philosophy:** Minimalist Functionalism combined with Modern Corporate Enterprise standards.
- **Visual Tenets:**
  - High information density without visual crowding.
  - Razor-sharp visual hierarchy driven by typography and structural hairline boundaries.
  - White surface containment against cool slate background tones.
  - Contextual color reserved strictly for statuses, actionable triggers, and critical alerts.

## Colors

The palette employs a cool neutral bedrock with dark slate structural elements, elevated by deliberate utilitarian accents and functional status tokens.

- **Base Canvas:** `#f8fafc` (Canvas background) with `#f1f5f9` (Subtle container / structural background).
- **Cards & Surfaces:** `#ffffff` for elevated cards, modal panels, and table rows.
- **Borders & Dividers:** `#e2e8f0` for crisp separation; `#cbd5e1` for hovered/focused structural dividers.
- **Primary Text:** `#0f172a` (Slate 900) for headers and core data points.
- **Secondary Text:** `#475569` (Slate 600) for labels, secondary columns, and helper text.
- **Tertiary / Disabled Text:** `#94a3b8` (Slate 400).
- **Primary Accent / Chrome:** `#1e293b` (Slate 800) used for global sidebar navigation, active structural navigation pills, and critical controls.
- **Interactive Action Blues:**
  - `#2563eb` (Blue 600) for primary actionable buttons, active link text, and focused inputs.
  - `#0284c7` (Sky 600) for informational tags, multi-step progress indicators, and filters.
- **Operational Status Semantic Tokens:**
  - **Approve / Success:** `#16a34a` (Green 600) background tint `#f0fdf4`, border `#bbf7d0`.
  - **Pending / Inactive:** `#57534e` (Stone 600) background tint `#f5f5f4`, border `#e7e5e4`.
  - **Warning:** `#d97706` (Amber 600) background tint `#fffbeb`, border `#fde68a`.
  - **Alert / Danger:** `#dc2626` (Red 600) background tint `#fef2f2`, border `#fecaca`.

## Typography

The type system is built on **Inter** to ensure maximum glyph clarity, compact ascenders/descenders, and superior legibility at small sizes. All numerical tables and ID displays utilize tabular figures (`font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'cv05' 1`) to ensure perfect vertical alignment across multi-column data grids.

- **Scale Purpose:**
  - `headline-xl` is reserved for core dashboard view titles.
  - `headline-lg` & `headline-md` establish clear hierarchy for modal headings, modular metric groups, and major card groupings.
  - `body-md` (13px) acts as the operational workhorse for table cells, descriptions, form field values, and system messages.
  - `label-sm` (11px uppercase) powers table headers, badge chips, status indicators, and column sort titles.
  - `code-tabular` applies to UUIDs, transaction hashes, IP addresses, and fleet telemetry records.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a fixed-sidebar layout paired with a 12-column fluid grid tailored for wide-format desktop displays (minimum target 1280px up to 4K workstations).

- **Global Layout Structure:**
  - **Global Sidebar:** Fixed 240px width (collapsible to 64px icon-rail mode for data-heavy viewports).
  - **Header Bar:** 52px fixed height, containing breadcrumb navigation, environmental selectors, search, and admin profile access.
  - **Canvas Canvas Pad:** Fixed 24px (`space-xl`) outer margins for full screen, reflowing to 16px (`space-lg`) on sub-1440px desktop screens.
- **Rhythm & Grid:**
  - Standard gutters are `1rem` (16px) with a compact density variant of `0.75rem` (12px) for analytical dashboards.
  - Row density inside tables and forms adheres to strict 32px (compact), 38px (regular), and 44px (spacious) vertical slot baselines.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual separation relies on structured borders and tonal shifts rather than dramatic floating drop shadows.

- **Border Hierarchy:**
  - Surface separation is driven by 1px solid hairline borders in `#e2e8f0`.
  - Focused or active structural boundaries shift to `#2563eb` with no layout shift.
- **Card Depth:**
  - Standard Cards: `#ffffff` surface, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, subtle ambient drop: `0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
  - Hovered Actionable Cards: Surface unchanged, border `#cbd5e1`, shadow: `0px 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), 0px 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Flyouts & Dropdowns:**
  - Dropdown Menus & Popovers: `#ffffff`, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, shadow: `0px 10px 15px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0px 4px 6px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`.
  - Modals & Side Sheets: `#ffffff`, backdrop overlay `#0f172a` at 40% opacity (`rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.40)`), with `0px 20px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1)`.

## Shapes

The design system employs a soft corner radius standard (`0.25rem` / `4px` to `0.375rem` / `6px`) reflecting geometric rigor, maximizing usable screen real estate, and providing a crisp administrative demeanor.

- **Base Corner Radius (4px / 0.25rem):** Form inputs, buttons, table cell wrappers, dropdown items, filter chips, checkboxes, and inline status badges.
- **Card & Modal Radius (6px / 0.375rem):** Content cards, data widgets, slide-over panels, and dialog surfaces.
- **Pill Radius (Full / 9999px):** Status bullet indicators, counter badges, and numerical notification flags only.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system serves high-velocity enterprise operators managing complex fleet, infrastructure, and administrative workflows. The aesthetic balance reflects precision engineering, clarity, and authority. Visual weight is deliberately understated to prioritize high-density data legibility, fast scanning, and zero-distraction administrative operations.

- **Design Philosophy:** Minimalist Functionalism combined with Modern Corporate Enterprise standards.
- **Visual Tenets:**
  - High information density without visual crowding.
  - Razor-sharp visual hierarchy driven by typography and structural hairline boundaries.
  - White surface containment against cool slate background tones.
  - Contextual color reserved strictly for statuses, actionable triggers, and critical alerts.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a fixed-sidebar layout paired with a 12-column fluid grid tailored for wide-format desktop displays (minimum target 1280px up to 4K workstations).

- **Global Layout Structure:**
  - **Global Sidebar:** Fixed 240px width (collapsible to 64px icon-rail mode for data-heavy viewports).
  - **Header Bar:** 52px fixed height, containing breadcrumb navigation, environmental selectors, search, and admin profile access.
  - **Canvas Canvas Pad:** Fixed 24px (`space-xl`) outer margins for full screen, reflowing to 16px (`space-lg`) on sub-1440px desktop screens.
- **Rhythm & Grid:**
  - Standard gutters are `1rem` (16px) with a compact density variant of `0.75rem` (12px) for analytical dashboards.
  - Row density inside tables and forms adheres to strict 32px (compact), 38px (regular), and 44px (spacious) vertical slot baselines.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual separation relies on structured borders and tonal shifts rather than dramatic floating drop shadows.

- **Border Hierarchy:**
  - Surface separation is driven by 1px solid hairline borders in `#e2e8f0`.
  - Focused or active structural boundaries shift to `#2563eb` with no layout shift.
- **Card Depth:**
  - Standard Cards: `#ffffff` surface, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, subtle ambient drop: `0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
  - Hovered Actionable Cards: Surface unchanged, border `#cbd5e1`, shadow: `0px 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), 0px 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Flyouts & Dropdowns:**
  - Dropdown Menus & Popovers: `#ffffff`, 1px border `#e2e8f0`, shadow: `0px 10px 15px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0px 4px 6px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`.
  - Modals & Side Sheets: `#ffffff`, backdrop overlay `#0f172a` at 40% opacity (`rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.40)`), with `0px 20px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Dark slate background `#1e293b`, white text, 32px height (desktop compact) or 36px (default), 4px border-radius, font-size 13px, font-weight 500, padding: 0 12px. Hover: `#0f172a`.
- **Accent (Action):** Background `#2563eb`, white text, hover: `#1d4ed8`.
- **Secondary / Outline:** Background `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#e2e8f0`, text `#0f172a`. Hover: `#f8fafc`, border `#cbd5e1`.
- **Destructive:** Background `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#fecaca`, text `#dc2626`. Hover: `#fef2f2`, border `#dc2626`.
- **Ghost / Icon-only:** Background transparent, text `#475569`, hover background `#f1f5f9`.

### Data Tables
- **Header:** Height 34px, background `#f8fafc`, border-bottom 1px solid `#e2e8f0`, typography `label-sm` in `#475569`, text-transform uppercase.
- **Rows:** Height 38px, background `#ffffff`, border-bottom 1px solid `#f1f5f9`, hover state `#f8fafc`.
- **Selection:** Checkbox column fixed at 40px width, selected rows highlight with background `#eff6ff` and left border `#2563eb`.

### Status Badges & Chips
- Status chips have a fixed height of 20px, 4px border-radius, padding 0 6px, typography `label-sm` (11px, weight 600).
  - **Approve:** Text `#16a34a`, background `#f0fdf4`, border 1px solid `#bbf7d0`.
  - **Pending:** Text `#57534e`, background `#f5f5f4`, border 1px solid `#e7e5e4`.
  - **Warning:** Text `#b45309`, background `#fffbeb`, border 1px solid `#fde68a`.
  - **Alert:** Text `#dc2626`, background `#fef2f2`, border 1px solid `#fecaca`.

### Form Inputs & Selectors
- **Input Fields:** Height 32px (compact) or 36px (default), background `#ffffff`, border 1px solid `#cbd5e1`, font-size 13px, text `#0f172a`.
- **Focus State:** Border color `#2563eb`, box-shadow `0 0 0 1px #2563eb`.
- **Placeholder:** `#94a3b8`.
- **Error State:** Border color `#dc2626`, box-shadow `0 0 0 1px #dc2626`.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Size 14px x 14px, border 1px solid `#cbd5e1`, border-radius 3px (checkbox) or circular (radio).
- Checked: Background `#2563eb`, border `#2563eb`, check glyph white. Focus ring: 2px offset with `#93c5fd`.

### Cards & Metrics Tiles
- Metric KPI tiles feature a 1px border `#e2e8f0`, background `#ffffff`, padding 16px.
- Displays small uppercase category label (`label-sm`), large quantitative value (`headline-lg` with tabular numbers), and contextual change indicator chip inline.

### Navigation Sidebar
- Background `#1e293b` (Dark Slate), width 240px.
- Nav Items: 34px height, 4px corner radius, text `#94a3b8`, font-size 13px, padding 0 10px.
- Active Nav Item: Background `#0f172a`, text `#ffffff`, font-weight 500, with optional 3px left border accent in `#2563eb`.

- **Interactive Action Blues:**

- **Operational Status Semantic Tokens:**
  - **Approve / Success:** `#16a34a` (Green 600) background tint `#f0fdf4`, border `#bbf7d0`.
  - **Pending / Inactive:** `#57534e` (Stone 600) background tint `#f5f5f4`, border `#e7e5e4`.

The design system employs a soft corner radius standard (`0.25rem` / `4px` to `0.375rem` / `6px`) reflecting geometric rigor, maximizing usable screen real estate, and providing a crisp administrative demeanor.

- **Base Corner Radius (4px / 0.25rem):** Form inputs, buttons, table cell wrappers, dropdown items, filter chips, checkboxes, and inline status badges.
